name: validate_schema
description: Validate a JSON payload against a strict JSON schema; returns valid flag and list of errors (byte-level conformance)

name: triage_route
description: Classify the user request and route it to the correct phase of the orchestration graph

phase.description: direct=simple local command; f1-discovery=needs brainstorm/planning; f4-execution=coding task with clear scope; escalate-cloud=too complex for local models

name: write_artifact
description: Persist a final artifact to the filesystem at the given path

name: upsert_vault
description: Upsert a note into the Obsidian vault (cerebro com IA)

name: emit_manifest
description: Emit the final artifact manifest with name, sha256, origin and metadata

artifact.description: artifact metadata: name, sha256, origin, version

name: run_shell
description: Execute a bash command locally to inspect state or run tests

command.description: full bash command including arguments and file paths
